## 维护者速读
- 用户能看到什么变化：字段设置了“只在某些条件下显示”时，记录详情页现在和编辑表单一样，条件不满足就不显示这个字段。一个分组里的字段全部隐藏时，连分组标题也不显示。
- 为什么做：在销售套件里测到，详情页会显示表单已经隐藏的字段，同一条记录在两处显示不一致。
- 出错会怎样：只影响页面显示，数据和接口不变。条件算不出来时照常显示，和表单一样。撤回即可。
- 要你做什么：无。

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT (L1-a) · repo:objectstack#5 · head `43ff1a5edf` · 2026-11-19T09:04Z
- **Shape:** 3 files, +455/−9: `record-details.tsx` (+72/−9), one new test file and one changeset. Not governed (check-governed: NOT governed, 464 lines). K = 10 since base `35c63310`, and it merges cleanly into current main.
- **Fixes vs card (#35314, Expected: "the default record page honours a field's `visibleWhen` the same way the form does"):**
  - The new `dropPredicateHidden` runs last on both the flat body (`filteredFields`) and each enumerated section's `fields`. It reads the object's own `Field.visibleWhen` by name, never a key on the section entry.
  - The verdict comes from `resolveFieldRuleState` in `@object-ui/core`, which is the same call `form.tsx` makes (lines 2180, 2258, 2354, 2501 and 3756). Its arguments are the record as `record` and as `previous`, plus the host predicate scope. So the fault direction is the field rule's: it fails open and warns once (ADR-0137 D3). That is the opposite of the group gate, which fails closed, and the code comment says so.
  - The lazy `sectionRecord` moved up and is shared by the group gate and the field gate through `predicateRecord()`. Group-gate behaviour is unchanged: groupVisibleWhen-11630 stays green.
- **Pins:** `record-details.fieldVisibleWhen-35314.test.tsx` renders every predicate case through both `record:details` and the real entry `form`. Each leg asserts the form's verdict, the page's verdict and the expected verdict, so two surfaces that are wrong the same way still fail. A `HARNESS DEAD` guard stops an empty render from passing as "hidden".
  - It was red on base for 14 of 19. The 5 that stayed green are controls and fail-open cases.
  - It covers `current_user` scope, every body shape and the empty-section heading.
  - `record-details` has no shared harness file, only per-card files like this one (the latest added 11-18), so a new file is the norm (ruling record 6583487846 does not apply).
- **Changeset:** `@object-ui/plugin-detail` patch, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. I read it sentence by sentence and it matches the code, including that it is display-only and the record API still serves the field. I checked `none` against AGENTS.md: the key's declared meaning ("field is shown only when TRUE (else hidden)") does not change, and the page now does what it already says. So this is not `semantic`.
- **Gates:** CI on `43ff1a5e` is 42 success and 13 skipped, with 0 failed and 0 pending. PR-side CI is a subset, so ux-2 triages any queue red.
- **Behaviour note, judged: no maintainer question.** Authored `record:details` bodies now hide a `visibleWhen`-false field too. Route A is the reading the spec text, the card's Expected (parity with the form) and ADR-0078 (no silently inert metadata) all give: the form already hides such a field on the same authored sections, and one key keeps one meaning. A page that showed the field was showing what its author declared hidden. This changes no product goal and can be undone by reverting. The changeset already says it reaches authored sections.
- **Deviations accepted:**
  - The PR body's 维护者速读 runs to os-dev.md's six lines. This record carries the four-line form.
  - The real app is NOT MEASURED because the container has no console build. The parity matrix against the real form renderer is the measurement.
- **Out of scope, needs a card:** `record:highlights`, the detail-view node and the drawer don't read a field's `visibleWhen` either. That is the same defect class on sibling surfaces, so ux-2 files one card nested under #35314 (p2, same grade class as the source).
- **Landing clause:** not governed, so ux-2 lands it. K < 15, so no main merge is required. A new push needs a fresh L1 only if it changes more than a main merge.
